disease.title: Crop Doctor
disease.subtitle: Upload a clear photo of one leaf to check for possible diseases.
disease.disclaimer: This is an AI estimate from a photo. It is not a diagnosis. Please confirm with a local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying or treating.
disease.analyzing: Checking... the first photo can take up to a minute.
disease.tip1: One leaf, close up, in daylight
disease.tip2: Plain background, in focus, no shadows
disease.tip3: Show the affected part of the leaf
disease.tip4: Use a JPEG or PNG photo (not HEIC)
disease.experimentalNote: Results for this crop are experimental: the model was tested on a small dataset and not on Indian field photos.
disease.noDiseaseNote: This does not mean the plant is healthy. The tool only checks for the diseases it knows. If the plant looks unwell, ask an agriculture expert.
disease.confidenceNote: This shows how sure the model is about the photo, not how likely the result is to be right in your field.
disease.noMatchText: The tool could not match this photo to a crop and condition it knows well enough to give an answer.
disease.noMatchNote: This does not mean the plant is healthy or diseased.
disease.historyEmpty: No checks yet. Your Crop Doctor results will appear here.
disease.historyError: Could not load your past checks.
disease.deleteConfirm: Delete this check? The photo will be deleted too.
disease.deleteError: Could not delete this check. Please try again.

errors.wrongType: Please choose a JPEG or PNG photo. If it is an iPhone HEIC photo, share it as JPG first.
errors.tooBig: The photo must be smaller than {{mb}} MB.
errors.invalid: This photo could not be used.
errors.unavailable: Crop Doctor is not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.timeout: This is taking too long. Please try again.
